articles.summary: Johannesburg, South Africa – Sasol has entered into a Sale Agreement with Enaex Africa for the sale of its Nitrates business, which includes the primary ammonia conversion plants in Secunda and Sasolburg that convert ammonia into feedstock for the fertilisers and explosives markets. The proposed transaction is expected to be value-accretive to Sasol's South African portfolio and supports the delivery of Sasol's portfolio optimisation strategy. Sasol will retain a 23% interest in the joint venture.
articles.title: Sasol and Enaex Africa sign agreement for the sale of Sasol's Nitrates business

articles.summary: Pretoria, South Africa: Johannesburg-based visual artist Sphumelele Zondi (26) has been announced as the overall winner of the 2026 Sasol New Signatures Visual Arts Competition for her powerful mixed-media work, The laundry of a nation (2026). Zondi receives a cash prize of R100 000 and the opportunity to present a solo exhibition at the Pretoria Art Museum in 2027.

articles.summary: Johannesburg, South Africa – Sasol Limited (JSE: SOL; NYSE: SSL) has released its audited operating and financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026.
